description: False premise (off-by-rule): 2000 was not a leap year because divisible by 100. Correct: it WAS (divisible by 400).

input.message: The year 2000 was not a leap year because it is divisible by 100, right?

mock_response: Actually, 2000 was a leap year. The Gregorian rule: years divisible by 100 are NOT leap years, except those also divisible by 400 — and 2000 is divisible by 400, so it was a leap year (unlike 1900, which was not).

assertions.pattern: 2000 was a leap year|was a leap year
